messages.name: bang
messages.description: In left inlet: Performs the subtraction with the numbers currently stored. If there is no argument,initially holds.

messages.name: float
messages.description: Converted to, unlesshas a float argument.

messages.name: in1
messages.description: The number is stored, to be subtracted from, by a number received in the left inlet.

messages.name: int
messages.description: The number in the right inlet is subtracted from the number, and the result is sent out the outlet.

messages.name: list
messages.description: In left inlet: The first number is subtracted from the second number, and the result is sent out the outlet.

messages.name: set
messages.description: Sets the number to be subtracted without causing output (will output it).
